slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Since every tool used in a stage must be sent for repair at the end of that stage, and repair costs are positive, is the objective to minimize the total cost (purchases + slow repairs + fast repairs) over all stages, with no salvage or terminal value for tools remaining at the end of stage n?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and proposed minimizing total cost, which covers the hidden objective slot.

slot_scores.name: mandatory_repair_after_each_stage
slot_scores.evidence_quote: At the end of each stage, can a tool be sent for repair only if it is actually broken/needed to be repaired, or can you choose to send any working tool for repair (slow or fast) as a strategic choice, regardless of whether it is broken?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether tools must be sent for repair after use, and the user clarified that every used tool must be repaired, covering the mandatory repair rule.

slot_scores.name: fast_repair_return_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For fast repair, is the timing the same pattern — a tool sent for fast repair at the end of stage j is unavailable only during stage j+1 and back in working condition at the start of stage j+q (so with q=1 it is available again at the start of the very next stage)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the exact return timing for fast-repaired tools, including stage boundaries.
